adversarialSelfReview: Did the fix change the 503 branch? No — git diff shows the 503 hunk untouched.
Did any existing test get weakened? No test assertion was relaxed. One test was removed for asserting a defect, and it is named here with its replacement.

Is the retirement safe? startPeCheckoutInstallScoped was module-private (no export keyword) with exactly two occurrences repo-wide: its declaration and the single call site. No dynamic import, no barrel re-export. startProCheckout aliases startPeCheckout, not the retired function.

Second mechanism for the grep result being empty: the function could be reached under another name via a re-export. Rejected by reading the export list of the module — every export is enumerated and none is the install-scoped function.
